$ claude-sessions machines --claude-dir <CLAUDE> --forget LAP-2
exit 0
--- stdout
Forgot "LAP-2": its manifest and index entries are removed.
Its transcripts, and their pages, stay in the archive: they are the
irreplaceable part. To stop publishing a project's pages, add it to
render-exclude.txt (or `claude-sessions render --exclude <project>`).
If that machine is still in use, its next push adds it back.
Run `claude-sessions push` to rebuild INDEX.md without it.
--- stderr
